Title: Decisions and development environment
Scope: Freeze one launch audience, two social channels, account ownership and existing theme; establish repository, feature branch, staging secrets and vendor API feasibility.
Acceptance: Named account owners and recovery contacts recorded privately | Staging access restricted; no production credentials in source | Ghost and Buffer integration feasibility recorded with manual fallback

Title: Ghost publication and role foundation
Scope: Configure Ghost publication and staff permissions with founders and a test invited Contributor.
Acceptance: Contributor can create own draft and cannot publish or edit another contributor draft | Reader identity cannot access staff admin | Site title, timezone and reply address are owner reviewed

Title: Existing theme and core public pages
Scope: Adapt an existing licensed theme to the chosen brand; implement home, story, sections, author, about and contribute routes.
Acceptance: Core routes readable on phone and desktop | Clear heading structure, contrast, focus state, image alt text and article metadata | No fabricated social proof, audience totals or invented contributor biographies

Title: Newsletter and reader account journey
Scope: Configure signup, preference management, confirmation and test-send workflow using native Ghost.
Acceptance: Consented test signup and unsubscribe complete | Web publication does not silently send newsletter | Sender and reply addresses verified before live send

Title: Private operations shell and auth
Scope: Create Next.js operations console with Supabase Auth, RLS and explicit staff/agent principals.
Acceptance: Unauthorized and disabled accounts cannot retrieve operational data | RLS policies enforce object ownership and staff-only source access | Server service keys absent from frontend bundles; no shared member/staff identity

Title: Pitch intake and source and rights records
Scope: Implement bounded pitch form, moderation disposition and private source/media permission records.
Acceptance: Public intake cannot enumerate submissions or upload executable files | Contact and permission records excluded from public article responses | Required source and credit fields visible during review

Title: Editorial queue and Ghost references
Scope: Link editorial items to canonical Ghost post IDs; add assigned owner, editorial status, section, region and species tags.
Acceptance: One unique Ghost post mapping per editorial item | Friend sees next action and exact native editor link | Operations states do not overwrite Ghost with unsupported status values

Title: Read-only review snapshots and stale detection
Scope: Capture append-only review snapshots, digest and Ghost updated_at; display changes and invalidate stale review indicators.
Acceptance: Edit after review creates stale banner and preserves earlier snapshot | Application role cannot edit or delete a completed snapshot | Review screen distinguishes web, newsletter and each social destination; no automated release button

Title: Scoped agent draft gateway
Scope: Implement the proposed internal contract with named agents, scoped access, strict field validation, expected revision and credential revocation.
Acceptance: Agent may create/update permitted drafts and suggest metadata | Agent publish, send, role-change, subscriber-export and published-edit attempts fail | Revoked agent is denied; request/revision conflicts are clear and logged without secrets

Title: Two-channel social drafts and Buffer adapter
Scope: Produce exact channel drafts, assets and dates; use a Buffer Needs Approval principal where supported; always provide copy/export fallback.
Acceptance: Agent-created Buffer output remains awaiting human approval | Manual export contains exact text, image credits, destination and canonical URL | Changed source item flags affected packs for human rechecking; native scheduling boundary disclosed

Title: Durable draft jobs and change reconciliation
Scope: Use Postgres jobs/outbox for draft operations, webhook ingestion and bounded periodic reconciliation; no auto-publication or bulk sends.
Acceptance: Repeated request does not create duplicate local work | Same key plus different payload returns conflict | Unknown provider acceptance enters needs-attention instead of blind retry | Duplicate webhook is harmless; missed event reconciliation updates stale status

Title: Podcast-ready episode article template
Scope: Add a reusable interview/episode article format with guest bio, show notes, transcript and optional external player; actual podcast hosting remains optional.
Acceptance: Episode without audio displays cleanly without dead controls | External media embed is accessible and carries ownership/consent reference | No unsupported claim of an existing distributed podcast

Title: Editorial policies and corrections visibility
Scope: Publish approved standards, guest guidance, correction contact and labels for opinion, reporting and sponsorship.
Acceptance: Policy pages linked from footer and submission flow | Correction timestamp and notice can be added without silently rewriting history | Founders sign off on actual wording and contact details

Title: Exports backup and restore procedure
Scope: Document and rehearse Ghost exports plus operations database/private asset backup and restore.
Acceptance: Recovery rehearsal restores sample content and linked operations records | Export inventory includes themes, routes, media, members and private rights assets as applicable | Owner can locate recovery credentials without developer intervention

Title: Launch failure-path and accessibility checks
Scope: Exercise permission, stale-review, retry and operator critical journeys; review public layout and metadata.
Acceptance: Acceptance matrix has actual evidence and results | No drafts exposed through public routes, feeds, previews or search | Unmet P0 behavior blocks release; remaining issues named and assigned

Title: Operator rehearsal and handoff
Scope: Rehearse guest draft to article to newsletter to social, then correction and recovery; capture concise how-to recordings and final runbook.
Acceptance: Friend completes the daily workflow without source-code access | Accounts, costs, handoff documents and support contact recorded | A founder authorizes actual launch only after reviewing staging results
